limitations: Sixteen scenario views reuse two authored basepairs, not sixteen independent networks.
Closed-origin base query errors/incomplete results retain not_observed/not_run; no zero-valued capture is invented.
Opaque assignments, modeled activity and per-side observations do not establish semantic IP sets, operational state or wider flow coverage.
A physical loopback disable was not treated as evidence of logical-unit inactivity; the final selected-unit fixture disables that unit explicitly.
Selection and concrete IPv4 origination eligibility are observed, not a complete ingress universe.
Active is a modeled property, not operational link state; missing concrete IPv4 remains unknown.
Source IP assignments are opaque engine renderings; equality and IP-set semantics are unverified.
After-context assignments for common eligible identities do not prove complete flow coverage.
Removed ingress, management access, external delivery, approval and safety are not established.
Admission byte limits are post-download checks, not hard HTTP receive-memory bounds.
Returned flows are examples, not all packets or the size of the affected flow space.
Differential queries use ingress locations present and active in both snapshots.
